phase_0.boundary_condition: The Zermelo-Fraenkel universe with the Axiom of Choice
phase_0.domain_name: Construction of a maximal sum-free set S such that
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: The addition of a specific ordinal to the set S to increase its density

AREV.justification: The removal of an element from the candidate pool to prevent sum-formation

CLINK.justification: The sequential application of the selection rule across all ordinals up to the continuum

ENGAGR.justification: Elements that simultaneously satisfy local sum-free conditions but threaten the global complement constraint

EVALF.justification: The identification of a forbidden triplet within the set structure

EVALT.justification: The confirmation that the candidate element does not violate the sum-free constraint

FFUSE.justification: The re-integration of the decision branches into the single evolving set S

FSPLIT.justification: The logical fork determining if a candidate element creates a sum within the existing set

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of an element into the set S or its complement

IMSCRIB.justification: The invariant condition where no two elements in the set add up to a third element in the set

TANCH.justification: The final bounded collection satisfying the density and complement constraints

VINIT.justification: The initial state before any integers or ordinals are selected for membership

phase_3.both_description: The undecidable state of an element before the transfinite induction reaches its index
phase_3.false_description: The state where a sum exists, forcing the element into the complement
phase_3.true_description: The state where x + y is not equal to z for all elements in the set
phase_3.void_description: The null set containing no numerical or ordinal values

steps.domain_action: Begin with an empty collection in the power set of the continuum
Define the sum-free identity as the governing constraint
Initiate transfinite induction over the ordinals
Evaluate the first candidate ordinal for sum-free compatibility
Confirm no sums exist with the current empty set
Include the ordinal in the set S
Fix the ordinal membership in the permanent record
Advance to the next ordinal index
Evaluate the next candidate ordinal against the current set S
Detect a sum-formation with previously fixed elements
Reject the ordinal from set S and move it to the complement
Fix the ordinal in the complement set
Encounter an element whose inclusion is required to prevent a continuum-sized sum-free set in the complement
Force inclusion to satisfy the maximal density requirement
Append the forced element to the set S
Close the set S once all ordinals up to the continuum are processed
